name: qgis-rs-py
description: Bun/Turbo facade for the qgis-rs Python package. All of its build, test, lint, format and coverage commands are defined HERE; they run through pixi because maturin and the interpreter with the QGIS-matched ABI exist only in pixi's default environment.

scripts.build: pixi run -e default maturin build --release -o dist
scripts.test: pixi run -e default bash -c 'maturin develop >/dev/null 2>&1 && QGIS_REQUIRE_NATIVE=1 python -m pytest tests -v'
scripts.coverage: pixi run -e default bash -c 'maturin develop >/dev/null 2>&1 && mkdir -p ../../target/coverage && QGIS_REQUIRE_NATIVE=1 python -m pytest tests -v --cov=qgis_rs --cov-report=term-missing --cov-report=xml:../../target/coverage/python-qgis-rs.xml'
